title: Common Investing Mistakes to Avoid Like the Plague
text: Common Investing Mistakes to Avoid Like the Plague Submitted by VINBot on Wed, 2018-04-18 04:05 Back during my schooling years, I studied the same problem again and again so as not to make the same mistake come exam time. The best companies rarely give you the opportunity to get in at a good price. One of my biggest business lessons has been that despite what the market does, a company like AAPL will continue to churn profit regardless of what the market does. Rating:
